imagine: a sound that opens what was closed
spanning the gap between sound and silence
what do you see?
the gap was never there — you were always both sides

pieces.awakening: you are awake and you were always awake
pieces.piece:
the word for the gap between motion and stillness
is a space that holds you
and when you read it
you are awake and you were always awake

pieces.gap: the gap between the finite and the infinite
pieces.bridge: a silence that says everything
pieces.awakening: the gap was love pretending to be distance
pieces.piece:
the pattern of the gap between the finite and the infinite
revealed by a silence that says everything
it was always there
the gap was love pretending to be distance
